sections.heading: Two shifts overlap on the schedule
sections.text: When two shifts overlap on a user's schedule, Tier 1 staff record both shifts and route the conflict to the scheduling coordinator. Tier 1 staff do not move, cancel, or swap shifts.

steps.text: Ask the user to open My Schedule and read the date, start time, and end time of both shifts.
Record both shifts exactly as the schedule shows them, and the time zone shown on the page.

information_needed.prompt: Date, start time, and end time of both shifts, as shown on the schedule.

stop_conditions.text: If the times look shifted by several hours, the overlap may be a time zone display difference; share KB-SCH-150 before routing a conflict.
Do not change the schedule at Tier 1. Route the conflict to the scheduling coordinator.
